notes.title: New Gameplay Features, upgraded graphics, delay
notes.content:
The game has gone through significant changes and new screenshots, video showcase will come in about 2 weeks.Therefore, game has been delayed, and the release date will be announced when ready.

New Gameplay: Game now has rock climbing, swimming, climbing up ladders, stairs, ledges.   Game also has environment related puzzles,.

Upgraded Graphics: Game has more detail than currently shown.

Hope to keep you updated soon!
